---
title: Subscribe
description: Find your feed URL and add it to a podcast app.
---

## Find your feed URL

Your feed URL is

```
https://<you>.github.io/<repo>/feed.xml
```

where `<you>` is your GitHub user name in lowercase and `<repo>` is the name of
your library repo. The summary of every earmark run in the **Actions** tab also
shows it.

## Add it to your podcast app

Your feed is private. It is not in any podcast directory, so you cannot find it
by searching. Give the app the feed URL:

| App | Where the URL goes |
|---|---|
| **Overcast** | **+** → **Add URL** |
| **Pocket Casts** | **Profile** → **Add RSS feed** |
| **AntennaPod** | **+** → **Add podcast by RSS address** |
| **Castbox** | Paste the URL into the search bar, then tap the result and **Subscribe** |
| **Apple Podcasts** | **Library** → **Edit** → *Add a Show by URL*. This works, but not reliably |

New episodes appear after the run finishes. Pull to refresh if your app has not
checked yet.

Podcast apps cache artwork and show titles for a long time. A new cover can
take hours to appear, even when new episodes arrive at once.
